# Assumption of Moses Chapter 4 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Latin palimpsest (Codex Ambrosianus) | **Section:** The Return, the Hasmoneans, and Antiochus

---

**1** Then when they return from among the nations and are restored to the land of their fathers, the two tribes will be restored to their land.

**2** Then certain men will arise among them who will hate sinners and love righteousness.

**3** But in those days men will arise who will call themselves priests of the Most High God; yet they will practice great deceit, for great wickedness will be found among them.

**4** They will prepare a golden lamp and will make a shrine for it in a foreign place, and they will defile the whole earth with the impurity of their practices.

**5** And they will not inquire of the Lord, because their hearts are given over to wickedness.

**6** They will be arrogant and will commit sin and will be profane in their handling of holy things.

**7** And they will say: we have great sin, but we shall not be judged.

**8** For they will love the glory that perishes and will turn to a foreign god.

**9** And then from one of the tribes will be raised up a powerful and mighty man.

**10** He will come and reign over Israel for thirty-four years.

**11** Then suddenly there will arise at his right hand a powerful enemy who will come and overthrow his kingdom.

**12** In those days powerful kings will come and take possession of them and will reign over them for thirty-four years.

**13** He will erect for them a building in the holy city in which he will offer sacrifices and serve him with foreign rites.

**14** He will do evil things among them and will afflict them in many ways.

**15** He will appoint over them an overseer to punish those who refuse to comply with his wicked decrees.

**16** He will make the uncircumcised circumcised and will force those who are circumcised to become uncircumcised.

**17** He will put many to death and will compel the survivors to follow the customs of the nations.

**18** In this way he will afflict them for a year and a half.
